intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a resource leak in mlx4_ib_create_srq by ensuring SRQ cleanup occurs on user data copy failure.
intent_record.what: Changed the error jump target for ib_copy_to_udata failure from err_wrid to err_srq and inserted a new err_srq label calling mlx4_srq_free before err_wrid.
intent_record.how: Ensures the SRQ resource is freed when user data copy fails, preventing a resource leak by executing SRQ cleanup before falling through to the existing DB unmap handler.

relevance_review.reason: The group explicitly targets the resource leak in the mlx4_ib_create_srq function described in the root cause, implementing the necessary SRQ cleanup logic to prevent the memory/resource leak on error paths.

vuln_statements.explanation: This error jump target in mlx4_ib_create_srq bypasses proper resource cleanup. When an error occurs after SRQ allocation but before completion, jumping to err_free_srq label may skip the mlx4_srq_free() call, leaving allocated SRQ resources unfreed.
